latest_release.name: v1.15.1 — security release
latest_release.body:
**Security release — we recommend all users upgrade.** v1.15.1 closes gaps in how sources are processed and requires content-core 2.2.1, which hardens URL fetching. It also ships the documentation rewrite and a handful of small fixes. Validated with the backend and frontend suites and a hands-on pass over the published 1.15.1 image.

## 🔒 Security

- Source processing now enforces the uploads-directory and URL checks in the background worker itself, so they apply on every path that processes a source, not only when a source is created.
- Requires `content-core` 2.2.1 or later, which refuses link-local and cloud-metadata addresses on every redirect hop when fetching URLs.
- `POST /api/commands/jobs`, the generic "submit any background command" endpoint, is removed. Nothing in Open Notebook used it; every operation has its own endpoint. Job status (`GET /api/commands/jobs/{job_id}`) is unchanged.

Security advisories with the details will be published on this repository.

## 📚 Documentation

Every page under `docs/` was checked against v1.15.0 and rewritten where it described an older or imagined product (#1458, #1459, #1460, #1461): one canonical install path built on the shipped `docker-compose.yml`, a first-run flow that ends in a working chat, a complete environment-variable reference, troubleshooting keyed on the exact error messages the app shows, and development docs rewritten from the code.

## 🐛 Notable fixes

- Timeouts no longer read as connection failures: a model that doesn't answer within `ESPERANTO_LLM_TIMEOUT` now says the provider took too long and how to raise the limit
- Error hints point to screens that exist (Manage → Models, Podcasts → Profiles) (#1457)
- Italian is selectable in the language menu, with dates formatted in Italian (#1457)
- `make start-all` starts SurrealDB again; the legacy `SURREAL_ADDRESS` / `SURREAL_PORT` fallback builds a valid database URL (#1457)
- Docs no longer recommend settings that do nothing (`API_CLIENT_TIMEOUT`, editing `.env` plus `docker compose restart`) (#1456)

## ⚠️ Behavior changes for self-hosters

- Anything that called `POST /api/commands/jobs` directly will now get `405 Method Not Allowed`. Use the specific endpoints (for example `POST /api/sources`) instead.
- A source whose file is outside the uploads directory, or whose URL targets a link-local or cloud-metadata address, now fails with a permanent error instead of being processed. Private and loopback addresses (Ollama, LM Studio, other local services) are still allowed.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/compare/v1.15.0...v1.15.1

## A private, multi-model, 100% local, full-featured alternative to Notebook LM ![New Notebook](docs/assets/asset_list.png) In a world dominated by Artificial Intelligence, having the ability to think 🧠 and acquire new knowledge 💡, is a skill that should not be a privilege for a few, nor restricted to a single provider. **Open Notebook empowers you to:** - 🔒 **Control your data** - Keep your research private and secure - 🤖 **Choose your AI models** - 20+ providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, vLLM) - 📚 **Organize multi-modal content** - PDFs, videos, audio, web pages, and more - 🎙️ **Generate professional podcasts** - Advanced
